messages:
Aisha: Hey leadership — quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: customer wins/losses. Can you share the top 3 themes for why we won and why we lost in the last quarter? People are asking for concrete asks we can action.

mgmt_jordan: +1. Short version: 1) We won when customers needed predictable latency + simple SLA (big win for Redwood Dedicated). 2) We lost mostly on procurement/security (on-prem/VPC gaps) and on unit economics for very high-volume embedding workloads. 3) Product fit timing: some teams wanted a turnkey hosted API with no infra work.

Tom: To add – wins also correlated with clear observability needs: teams that needed token-level cost breakdowns found our Console and Optimize suggestions very persuasive.

Priya: Example — Healthcare prospect: we lost because their security team required HSM integration and air-gapped deployment. We submitted SOW but timeline + cost didn't make sense for them.

Carlos: Noted. Can we get a prioritized list of asks we should push into the roadmap or into sales playbooks? I'm hearing: private deployment packaging, HSM/KMS, and better pricing for embeddings (volume discounts). Anything else?

mgmt_jordan: Priorities from leadership POV: 1) Private deployment turnkey (P0) — critical for regulated verticals. 2) HSM/KMS + audit export (P1) — needed for compliance deals. 3) Embedding unit economics playbook (P1) — variable pricing + burst pools. 4) Improve hosted SLA language and faster Dedicated onboarding (P2).

Sophie: For the private package, engineering asks for 3 concrete use cases to scope effort. Can sales ops / solutions provide anonymized examples? @Priya @Carlos can you drop 1–2 anonymized stories here?

Priya: Sure — I'll DM anonymized notes. Short paste: "healthcare customer required on-prem key management, no internet egress, 24hr support for incident ops" — status: lost. Another: "fintech needed <10ms 95p latency for short prompts, we couldn't guarantee with hosted plan" — moved to competitor.

Carlos: Thanks. Suggestion: we create a one-pager per ask with: problem, risk, proposed solution, estimated impact. I can own the first draft for private deployment.

Tom: I'll put a placeholder on the roadmap for Q3 to evaluate private deployment packaging and add a spike for HSM integration. Also tagging product ops to define KPIs.

Aisha: Can leadership share how these map to sales motions? e.g., when do we escalate to enterprise sales vs. self-serve?

mgmt_jordan: Rule of thumb: escalate when a buyer requests non-standard infra (on-prem/VPC/HSM) or contract terms > 1 year / $100k ARR equivalent. Otherwise try to keep in self-serve or dedicated offer. We'll refine thresholds but want speed to market.

DevRelBot: Recording + notes from today's all-hands: https://redwood.internal/handbook/allhands/2378001122 — transcript and Q&A section attached.

Priya: One quick ask from field — can we add a standard canned response + pricing ballpark for embedding-heavy pilots? Sales gets stuck on the first call without numbers.

Tom: Good idea. @Sophie @Carlos let's create a simple FAQ + pricing template. I'll allocate 0.5 PM to coordinate.

Aisha: Perfect — thanks everyone. If we can get first drafts by end of next week, I'll surface to ops and customer success for review. :thumbsup:

mgmt_jordan: Appreciate the quick alignment. We'll follow up in next week's leadership sync with owners and timelines.
